title: Playwright visual regression test harness
description: Set up Playwright in the themes monorepo with a minimal HTML test page that renders theme tokens as visual components (buttons, cards, forms, text, status badges). Test page accepts ?theme= query param to load different themes.
acceptance_criteria: Test page in packages/themes/tests/visual/ renders all semantic token categories

evidence.context: ADR-005 accepted — implement before adding themes beyond the current 8
